column1: # Second sweep, embed_dim fixed at 32 throughout (--num-heads 4, head_dim=8).
# The first sweep (sweep_configs.tsv) varied width among other things and, once
# evaluated at full spatial resolution instead of pool_spatial, showed 32
# dims/patch already matches 256 dims/patch (see STATE.md). So width is no
# longer a free axis here -- every line below fixes it and varies only what
# is still unexplored: a finer learning-rate grid (the first sweep only had
# 5e-5 / 2e-4 / 1e-3, and 5e-5 was still visibly climbing at epoch 21) and
# weight decay, plus the mask schedule that led the full-resolution table
# 5 epochs, per the "epoch 1-3 already tells you if it works" rule -- the
# embed-dim scan needed only 3 to separate 8/16/32/64, and the full-resolution
# curve above was already flat by epoch 3 for every config tried so far.
